exploratory.text: E: vsgo effect (no directional prediction in XIX; distribution reported).
M: rsg = replication of XIX M_P5_frzp_nil plus an upstream-gradient change (review A B2: not discriminating).
Every hypothesis re-evaluated at the historical horizon 1211 (secondary).
Stability 4000 -> 12000: low-LR (peak 1e-4) and full-LR positive control (peak 1e-3); wording limited to 'class unchanged under this continuation' unless the full-LR control moves some organisation.
Unconditional sensitivity: over every pair with a native B anchor, the arm's class and its concordance with the same pair's fullI class.
High-preset extra arms: exploratory, no frozen prediction.
M: layer-2-QK-only transplant from the vsgo window (localises HA10a; exploratory).

hypotheses.text: Blocking the base's own route for the first 100 steps switches the organisation: the I anchor is competent and of the opposite causal class at 4000.
The step-100 parameters carry the selection (I parameters with B moments -> I-like).
Adam moments alone do not carry it (B parameters with I moments -> B-like).
E: the I layer-0 state is sufficient (near-tautological; replication anchor, not a finding).
E: the I layer-0 state is necessary (restoring B's layer 0 prevents the switch); INCOMPATIBLE pairs are not evidence.
M: L0 alone is not sufficient (weak negative claim; not headlined).
M: restoring B's L0+L2 prevents the switch; INCOMPATIBLE pairs are not evidence.
A random displacement of the sufficiency groups with matched per-group norm does not reproduce the effect.
Label-noise loss disturbance (valid strength only) does not reproduce the effect.
M: removing V+O learning through the blocked route suffices (XIX replication).

M (new): the QK WEIGHTS (all layers) learned under vsgo suffice. This is a QK-weights vs non-QK-weights test, not a pure routing-vs-value test (vsgo changes the layer-0/1 QK gradients on M; review A r2 N1). Evaluated only in pairs whose vsgo arm is I-like. Interpretation table: DESIGN §1.
M (new): the non-QK weights learned under vsgo do not suffice (complement of HA10a; only in pairs whose vsgo arm is I-like).

E: removing the routing gradient of the layer-0 readout rows (all edges) gives a PARTIAL, HYBRID-class outcome. Basis: one dev run (uP160, D801, step 1211). Overlaps XIX E_P5_frzp_partial; SUPPORTED distinguishes little, a CONTRA outcome is the informative one.
Persistence: each anchor's causal class at 1211 equals its class at 4000 and it is competent at 4000 (>= 80% of evaluable pairs per parent).

parent_rule.contra_rule: C >= ceil(n/2) and C > S (review A r2 N4)

validity.incompatible_rule: a composed state is INCOMPATIBLE if its KL at step 100 (composed state) exceeds both window states' KL, or at step 150 / 300 exceeds both anchors' KL, by more than 0.10 (uncalibrated; flag rates and 0.05 / 0.20 sensitivity reported). A supporting outcome of a flagged transplant (any transplant arm) is relabelled INCOMPATIBLE (not evidence)
